_doc: Every test of the board-agnostic validation, defined once (tests/common/catalogue.py). Shield-specific tests live on the application branches.

tabs.title: Framework
tabs.question: Does the test framework itself work: runner, record, review page and control center, without hardware?
notes: Run `tests/run_all.sh --l0`. The review page needs `.venv`: `python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r tests/requirements.txt`.

tabs.title: On target
tabs.question: Can a test firmware be built, flashed and read over SWD on a Spin?
notes: On-target tests run through an ST-Link: `tests/run_all.sh --l0 --target`. They reflash the Spin on the ST-Link: flash its usual firmware again afterwards. Without `--target` they report BLOCKED.

tabs.title: SPOC bench
tabs.question: Is the SPOC bench fit to judge a test: dividers trimmed, scope readings steady, gain and skew recorded?
notes: SPOC tests run on the SPOC bench only when asked: `tests/run_all.sh --l0 --target`, or the test's own `run.sh --run`. CUT on Core-CUT, MUX on Core-MUX, MHO984 on USB: `bash tests/common/spoc_preflight.sh`.

tabs.title: Timing
tabs.question: How many cycles do the Core API hot-path calls and the critical task cost on the Spin, and did a change make them slower?
notes: On-target, like the On target tab: `tests/run_all.sh --l0 --target` or `tests/l0/target_timing/run.sh --run`. Verdicts are INFO until `tests/l0/target_timing/reference.json` holds a reference run; then a row regresses when its mean exceeds the reference by more than max(10 %, 3σ) + 50 cycles (Core-staging#35). The reference run on main and pre-zephyr-4.4: `tests/l0/target_timing/reference_run.sh`.

tabs.title: PWM
tabs.question: Does every spin.pwm (PwmHAL) call do what its documentation says, on the registers, on the pins and on the scope? (API regression suite, Core-staging#35/#38)
notes: One firmware for the module (env PWM, tests/firmware/pwm): the host commands steps over SWD and judges the HRTIM registers it reads itself, the pins sampled on the chip and the scope through the SPOC MUX (CH1 and CH4, the two independent nodes, #5). On-target: `tests/run_all.sh --l0 --target`. Supervised rows (hand-held probes until #16) need `--supervised` and run only on Luiz's computer.
Known failures (catalogue `known_failure`) fail on main and on the baseline: reported as known, they do not fail the campaign (#35). L0-HRI (Core#172) belongs to this module.
